home.metaDesc: Specialised structural rehabilitation for concrete, steel and process piping using advanced carbon fiber technology, composite materials and epoxy coatings.
home.heroSubtitle: Seema delivers advanced carbon fiber technology, composite systems and protective coatings for concrete, steel and process piping across Saudi Arabia's industrial sector.

intro.title: Engineered repair for concrete, steel and process piping.
intro.body: Seema General Contracting & Industrial Services Co. specialises in structural rehabilitation services for the maintenance and support of concrete and steel structures and the repair of process piping — using advanced carbon fiber technology, composite materials and epoxy coatings designed for extreme corrosive environments.

home.servicesSubtitle: From carbon fiber reinforcement to acid-resistant linings — engineered solutions across the lifecycle of industrial assets.
home.projectsTitle: Delivered for the Kingdom's heaviest industries.
home.ctaTitle: Have a structure or pipeline that needs rehabilitation?
home.ctaBody: Send us the scope. We'll come back with an engineered approach, a timeline and a proposal.

values.missionBody: Introduce specialised engineered services and solutions, and build a specialised maintenance team in the rehabilitation field — collaborating with international companies to transfer technology, training and technical support.
values.goalBody: Team up with international companies to bring specialised engineered services, well-trained skilled personnel and localised service support to the industrial sector.
values.visionBody: Partner with international and local companies in civil engineering, structural maintenance and civil construction to be among the market leaders in our field.

services.metaDesc: Carbon fiber reinforcement, FRP repair of concrete and steel, process piping repair, leak repair, epoxy coatings, acid lining, expansion joints, waterproofing and industrial supplies.
services.title: Services & Sales
services.subtitle: Engineered repair solutions, carbon fiber sales and industrial material supplies.
services.salesTitle: Sales of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymers
services.salesBody: We supply carbon fiber fabric — unidirectional and multi-directional — with GSM ranging from 150 to 900. Contact us by email to check availability.

carbon.title: Carbon Fiber Reinforcement (FRP)
carbon.body: Engineered repair solutions using advanced composite systems — carbon fiber reinforcement and FRP for concrete and steel structures.

piping.title: Process Pipe Repair
piping.body: Repair of process pipes using high-strength carbon fiber systems, including in-service leak repair for pressurised lines.

concrete.title: Concrete Repair
concrete.body: General concrete repair using conventional methods, epoxy grouts and crack injection for structural restoration.

epoxy.title: Industrial Coatings
epoxy.body: Application of coating systems engineered for extreme corrosive environments — protecting tanks, structures and containment.

acid.title: Acid Lining
acid.body: Composite carbon fiber lining systems rated for 98% sulfuric acid and 54% phosphoric acid concentrations.

joints.title: Expansion Joints
joints.body: Repair and replacement of expansion joints in industrial and civil structures.

roof.title: Roof Repair & Waterproofing
roof.body: Roof repair and waterproofing services for industrial and commercial facilities.

supplies.title: Industrial Material Supplies
supplies.body: Supply of industrial materials, composites and protective coatings to support project and maintenance teams.

about.metaTitle: About — Seema General Contracting & Industrial Services
about.metaDesc: Founded in 2013, Seema is a Saudi specialist in the rehabilitation of concrete, steel structures and process pipes — partnering with international firms to bring engineered solutions to local industry.
about.title: A specialist contractor for what cannot fail.
about.lead: SEEMA General Contracting & Industrial Services Co. was established in 2013 with a specialised team of professionals and technicians engaged in the rehabilitation of concrete, steel structures and process pipes.
about.body1: We carry out repairs to concrete and steel structures and process pipes using epoxy materials, advanced carbon fiber and fiber-glass wrappings, concrete injections and industrial coating systems.
about.body2: We collaborate and partner with international and local companies in the field of civil engineering, structural maintenance and civil construction — transferring technology, training and technical support to the Kingdom's industrial sector.
about.vendorsBody: Seema is an approved vendor with the Kingdom's leading industrial operators.

projects.metaDesc: Major orders completed by Seema for SABIC, Aramco, Maaden, SAFCO, KJO, S-Chem and Berry Gas Plant across Jubail, Ras Al Khair and Khafji.
projects.title: Major Orders Completed
projects.subtitle: A snapshot of rehabilitation, CFRP lining and structural repair work delivered across the Kingdom's industrial sites.

items.title: Rectification of a large compressor foundation, fire proofing

CFRP lining on K01/K02/K03 casings and R02/R03 agitator shafts — PAP Train-A emergency TAM
CFRP corrosion protection on various components — PAP Train-C TAM Nov 2018
Additional CFRP works on various components — PAP Train-C TAM
